result.summary: Removing the clamp reintroduces incorrect progress and completion indicators for extracted files.

findings.title: Extracted files display progress above 100% and lose completion indicators
findings.body: For local_size=20 and remote_size=10, this now produces 200 instead of 100. transfer-row.component.html renders that value directly at line 28 and requires exactly 100 for success styling and the “Done” indicator at lines 33 and 53. Its width clamp at line 35 protects only bar width, so these other paths demonstrably lose protection. Existing service test vectors explicitly expect 100 for this case and would fail.
findings.recommendation: Restore Math.min(100, ...) around the computed percentage and retain the existing extracted-file regression cases.

next_steps: Restore the clamp and run the ViewFileService unit tests.
